instruction: You are facing towards the mirror and the shrink, turn to your left then you will be seeing an open door towards the bedroom. Move towards the bed, turn slight left from the bed facing towards the chair and a cabinet, slightly turn to your right towards the open door. Move near the open door and exit from the room. Turn to your right immediately after exiting from the door, move forward and there will be an immediate left room and there are two two rooms to your left, move towards to your left side room and enter into the room. Stand in front of a bathroom door. It will be your destination.
